name: TaskWeaver
test_cmd: mkdir -p "$ENV/home" "$ENV/tmp" && HOME="$ENV/home" TMPDIR="$ENV/tmp" $PY -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/unit_tests
notes: CI (pytest.yml, matrix [3.11]) runs `pip install -e .`, then `pip install pytest pytest-cov`, then `pytest tests/unit_tests -v --cov=com`. The recipe skips pytest-cov and --cov because coverage has no effect on pass/fail. test_env GITHUB_ACTIONS=true reproduces CI's own deselection: 14 tests are skipped via skipif(IN_GITHUB_ACTIONS) because they need HF/sentence-transformers downloads, a real LLM, or a Jupyter kernel/docker. Those are test_embedding x5, test_environment x3, test_role x2, and test_experience, test_multi_llm, test_plugin_selector, test_tracing x1 each. The LLM-touching tests that do run use TaskWeaver's built-in MockApiService (llm.use_mock). Tests leave gitignored artifacts in $SRC (logs/, taskweaver/cli/taskweaver-project.zip), which git status hides. Resolved openai==3.29.0. Common: setup runs from the router-migrate root (each step sources scripts/env.sh so uv caches/Pythons stay in .tools); --exclude-newer 2026-10-13T00:00:00Z pins dependency resolution to the baseline date. test_cmd sandboxes HOME and TMPDIR into $ENV/home and $ENV/tmp so tests never read or write the real ~ (e.g. ~/.config) or /tmp. Baseline was taken with outbound network denied (macOS sandbox-exec, loopback allowed), so the tests are confirmed offline. Rebuilt from scratch into a second env (<name>-check): identical uv pip freeze and identical counts. Check-run counts: 100 passed, 14 skipped, 4 warnings in 24.41s (24.7s).
